• Led development and maintenance of 6+ Ruby on Rails client applications, delivering scalable architecture and complex business logic across projects.
  • Optimized React.js interfaces and implemented Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus.js), reducing initial page load time by ~35% and removing full-page reloads in key flows.
  • Migrated monolithic systems to microservices on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), reducing inter-service latency by 40%.
  • Built and maintained RESTful APIs supporting 500K+ monthly requests while sustaining 99.9% uptime.
  • Implemented comprehensive test suites with RSpec and Jest, achieving 87% code coverage and reducing production bug reports by 35%.
  • Designed and optimized PostgreSQL schemas and indexing strategies, cutting critical query execution time by up to 60%.
  • Established CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI and AWS CodePipeline, reducing deployment cycle time from ~45 minutes to under 8 minutes.
  • Mentored 3 junior engineers through weekly code reviews and practical coaching in Rails and React.js best practices.
  • Collaborated with product managers and designers to translate business requirements into technical specifications and sprint-ready deliverables.

• Developed scalable RESTful APIs and backend services with Ruby on Rails for high-traffic applications with consistent sub-200ms response times.
  • Contributed to React.js frontend development, improving UX responsiveness and reducing client-reported UI issues by 25%.
  • Integrated 10+ third-party APIs including payment, analytics, and communication services for reliable cross-system data exchange.
  • Created and maintained unit and integration test coverage with RSpec, improving reliability and reducing regression debugging time.
  • Helped the team adopt Agile/Scrum, contributed to sprint planning, and kept technical documentation current for cross-functional partners.
  • Participated actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and raise overall code quality.

frontmatter.title: Helios
frontmatter.summary: Helios is a workflow platform that runs medical translation projects end to end — from file intake to vendor coordination, delivery, and invoicing. It replaced a process run on email and spreadsheets with one auditable system.

frontmatter.title: Quoting
frontmatter.summary: Quoting is a quote-management platform that turns a healthcare translation request into an accurate, versioned price quote. It centralizes pricing rules, tracks every revision, and hands approved quotes straight to delivery.

frontmatter.title: AListEngine
frontmatter.summary: AListEngine is an AI tool that turns product photos into ready-to-publish listings for e-commerce stores and auction houses. It drafts the title, description, and price, then exports to Shopify, AuctionFlex, and LiveAuctioneers.

frontmatter.title: NEPSE Trade Journal
frontmatter.summary: A full-stack trading journal for Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) traders: plan, execute, and review trades, keep a daily journal, track a portfolio, and see analytics like win rate, P&L, and expectancy.
